name: WNYMesh
tagline: A Western New York community communication network.
description: WNYMesh helps Western New York neighbors stay connected when the power and cell service go out, through a volunteer-built community radio network, preparedness education, and events that bring people together.
taxStatus: WNYMesh Inc. is a New York not-for-profit corporation recognized by the IRS as a 501(c)(3) public charity. Donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
boardNote: WNYMesh is led by a five-member volunteer Board of Directors. We'll introduce the rest of the board here soon.

partners.name: Rokland
partners.description: Rokland is a US-based distributor of the radios and parts our network runs on, including RAKwireless, Heltec and Elecrow gear. Orders ship from within the US, so there are no import tariffs or long overseas waits. It's where we point new members for their first radio and where we source parts for our solar repeaters.

partners.name: Seeed Studio
partners.description: Seeed Studio designs and builds hardware for MeshCore and Meshtastic, including the SenseCAP Solar Node P1, XIAO boards and Wio trackers. It's a good place to buy a ready-made solar node or a compact radio to build into your own project.

products.name: XIAO nRF52840 & Wio-SX1262 Kit
products.note: A small, low-power board to build into your own radio or enclosure.

products.name: SenseCAP Solar Node P1-Pro
products.note: A good all-in-one, no-build solar node. Its range is usually modest, though: fine for a house close to the mesh, but not suited to a regional backbone or a neighborhood hub.
products.couponNote: 5% off the Solar Node P1 series

affiliateDisclosure: WNYMesh Inc. earns a small commission when you buy through our partner links, at no extra cost to you. It goes toward radios, solar panels and batteries for the network.
